recommendation.explanation: Earlier 31 was 23 true geometry donors plus eight records with no mesh donor: two trophy cabinets, three machines, three schematic wall racks. It did not mean 31 complete reused meshes. No geometry change occurred for this count correction.
recommendation.report: Library libfile_5108885ae63881918f47561f0b39a96f version 1 already states 23 actual geometry, eight non-geometry/style records, 37 other generic.
recommendation.print_recommendation: Create a separate simplified furniture variant from B04: prioritize bleacher stepped banks, locker benches, sofas/Commons seating, trainer treatment tables/whirlpool/counters and fitness silhouettes. Fuse/thicken at target scale; omit tiny racks, trophy contents and photo panels unless resolvable. Preserve room envelopes, original print variant and frozen B04/R03. Run manifold, minimum-feature, floor-attachment and slicer checks; digital visualization meshes are not certified printable.
